verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.agentmail.to/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an AgentMail documentation index. Every doc page is also served as a .md file, an OpenAPI spec is published, and the docs include agent-oriented material: an agent self-registration quickstart and installable agent skills for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents successfully consuming these docs, and evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-content dump.
